panels.name: One Outlook Web Sign-Ins
panels.query: index=* sourcetype="azure:aad:signin" appDisplayName="One Outlook Web" | table _time userPrincipalName ipAddress location.city status.errorCode | sort - _time

panels.name: Inbox Rule Creation
panels.query: index=* Workload=Exchange Operation=New-InboxRule | table _time UserId Name DeleteMessage ForwardTo SubjectContainsWords | sort - _time

panels.name: Mailbox Forwarding
panels.query: index=* Workload=Exchange Operation=Set-Mailbox | table _time UserId ForwardingSmtpAddress DeliverToMailboxAndForward | sort - _time

panels.name: Message Trace
panels.query: index=* sourcetype="o365:reporting:messagetrace" | table Received SenderAddress RecipientAddress Subject Status FromIP | sort - Received
